title: Dataset Profiling Request
description: Input to the Dataset Profiling module. Generic: works for any tabular dataset. Status: proposed, pending Team 1 review.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Must equal 1.0-draft until the contract is approved.

request_id.description: Caller-generated id. Echoed in the response.

source_type.description: How the data is delivered. Only 'file' is implemented; other types wait for Team 2's decision.

location.description: File path for source_type 'file'. Optional when the caller passes an already-loaded table to the module.

metadata.description: Optional hints about the dataset. Never required.

format.description: File format. Inferred from the file extension when omitted.

sheet_name.description: Excel sheet name or 0-based index. Default: first sheet.

missing_value_markers.description: Extra strings to treat as missing (for example NA, n/a).

identifier_columns.description: Columns the caller declares as identifiers. Their sample values are never reported.

top_n_values.description: Number of most frequent values reported for categorical columns. Default 5.

include_statistics.description: Include the per-column summary statistics. Default true.

target_column.description: Optional. Column to treat as the target. Adds class_distribution to the response when the target has few distinct values.

include_correlations.description: Include correlations between numerical columns. Default true.
